claims.primary_question: Does separating timed-reference representation, observation freshness, controller and compute change a useful VLA execution decision?
comparators: A2C2 with separately accounted training and information
reject_if: normal native competence cannot be established
simple tuning or known methods fully explain the finding
only a one-off implementation error is demonstrated
revise_if: effect is limited to one controller or task
gain or freshness rather than representation explains the difference

resume_requirements: one coherent task/checkpoint/normalizer/controller/evaluator packet with physical-time semantics
a concrete prediction distinguishable from existing fixed-horizon, RTC, AAC or A2C2 explanations
fair interventions and budget accounting; efficacy need not be proven before the pilot
before execution, lock native runtime, reset, seed, split, sample budget and decision thresholds
